title: [29.x] Reversed output entry stays uninvoiced (Invoiced Quantity = 0) after reopening a finished production order, causing quantity discrepancy in Inventory Valuation
summary: After a finished production order is reopened, the reversed output entry no longer stays uninvoiced with Invoiced Quantity = 0. This removes the quantity discrepancy it caused in Inventory Valuation. The fix is in Calc. Inventory Adjmt. - Order.
key_points: Reversed output entries are no longer left with Invoiced Quantity = 0 after a finished production order is reopened
Removes the quantity discrepancy in Inventory Valuation
Small change in the Calc. Inventory Adjmt. - Order codeunit
Production order tests updated and extended
